title: The Lion and the Bull
moral: Do not believe in rumors without knowing the truth.

scenes.summary: A bull enters the forest and meets the lion.
scenes.text: Once upon a time, a strong bull lived near a forest. One day, he wandered into the forest. The lion, king of the forest, heard his loud voice.

scenes.summary: The lion and bull become friends but others grow jealous.
scenes.text: Soon, the lion and the bull met and became good friends. They spent time together every day. But two jackals became jealous of their friendship.

scenes.summary: The jackals spread lies to both the lion and the bull.

story: Once upon a time, a strong bull lived near a forest. One day, he wandered into the forest and began living there. Nearby, a lion was the king of the forest. The lion heard the loud sound of the bull and became curious. Soon, the lion and the bull met and became good friends. They spent time together every day. But two jackals in the forest became jealous. They wanted to break their friendship. The jackals went to the lion and said, “The bull wants to become king and defeat you.” Then they went to the bull and said, “The lion is planning to attack you.” Both the lion and the bull became scared and angry. One day, they fought each other. In the end, the lion defeated the bull. After the fight, the lion felt sad. He realized he had lost a good friend because of lies.
